## Not here {#gaps}

What the workbook doesn't have on compliance and evidence, and whether it should. [All topics](index.md#gaps) shows the same for every topic.

| Missing | Why |
|---|---|
| Guide | Not needed, because every implementation guide carries its own Evidence section, and Book 15's day-two runbook, under Build, is the operating guide. |
| Developer workbook | Not needed, because Book 19's Chapters 03 and 09, under Build, are the validation kit and drift pipeline build. |
| Learning path | Not needed, because the two modules under Learn teach the validation kit and the drift pipeline, and each topic's own path teaches that topic's evidence. |
| Labs | Not needed, because those modules carry the labs. |
